title: Order API 5xx and P99 latency rise
description: A configuration change reduced the order API's database connection pool from 20 to 2. Under a concurrent traffic increase the pool saturates, requests queue, latency rises and the service returns 500s. Two coincidences make the wrong answer look right: the traffic increase is real but the same load was served without error two days earlier, and the database really did drop out for two minutes at onset — long enough to look like the cause, far too short to explain twenty minutes of errors.

annotations.summary: 5xx rate above 10% for 5 minutes; p99 latency above 2s
